tasks.title: Set up a safe working area
tasks.conditionalPrompt: Show the work area, hazards and controls before starting.

tasks.title: Select and use PPE / RPE
tasks.conditionalPrompt: Show the PPE/RPE and explain why it is needed for this task.

tasks.title: Follow RAMS, induction or toolbox information
tasks.conditionalPrompt: Show or describe the safe system of work and how it affects today's task.

tasks.title: Read a drawing or specification
tasks.conditionalPrompt: Show the drawing/specification and explain the dimensions or requirements you are using.

tasks.title: Work to regulations and required standards
tasks.conditionalPrompt: Explain the standard/regulation that applies and show where it affects the work.

tasks.title: Use digital drawings or modelling information
tasks.conditionalPrompt: Show the digital information and explain how you used it.

tasks.title: Select bricks, blocks and components
tasks.conditionalPrompt: Show the materials/components selected and explain why they are suitable.

tasks.title: Estimate quantities for today's work
tasks.conditionalPrompt: Show the area/measurements and explain how you estimated what is needed.

tasks.title: Choose materials with sustainability in mind
tasks.conditionalPrompt: Explain the material choice, its characteristics, waste/reuse considerations and any building-performance effect.

tasks.title: Select and use hand tools
tasks.conditionalPrompt: Show safe selection and use of the hand tools needed for the task.

tasks.title: Maintain and store hand tools
tasks.conditionalPrompt: Show cleaning/checking/storage and explain what you look for.

tasks.title: Use a power tool safely
tasks.conditionalPrompt: Show the setup and controls; do not film while holding a phone and operating the tool.

tasks.title: Explain how building components work together
tasks.conditionalPrompt: Use the work in front of you to explain how the components protect or perform as part of the building.

tasks.title: Segregate waste and prevent contamination
tasks.conditionalPrompt: Show waste segregation or contamination controls and explain what happens to each material.

tasks.title: Protect materials and finished work
tasks.conditionalPrompt: Show protection against weather or construction damage and explain why it is needed.
